class.name: HTMLWindow
class.brief_description: The event target for a live document window.
class.description: Every document exposes one window handle through [method HTMLDocumentNode.get_default_view]. Listeners registered on it run first in the capture phase and last in the bubble phase, which makes it the natural place for shortcuts and document-wide handlers. The first successful layout dispatches [code]DOMContentLoaded[/code] on the document and then [code]load[/code] on the window. A changed HTML viewport dispatches a non-bubbling [code]resize[/code] event after layout; initial layout does not dispatch one. Godot OS window focus notifications dispatch non-bubbling [code]focus[/code] and [code]blur[/code] events. A window becomes invalid when the layout replaces or clears its document. Omitted [code]passive[/code] defaults to [code]true[/code] for [code]wheel[/code], [code]touchstart[/code], and [code]touchmove[/code].

method.name: get_document
method.description: Returns the document node this window belongs to, or [code]null[/code] when the window is invalid.

members.member: The document node this window belongs to.
